title_sq: NJESI PER SHITJE TEK REZIDENCA PARK AVENUE – BULERVARDI I RI
description_sq:
Shitet njesi biznesi tek Rezidenca Park Avenue, projekt i Orion Construction, ne Bulervardin e Ri. Njesia ka siperfaqe 204.2 m² bruto, ndodhet ne katin e 5-te te nje objekti te ri te dedikuar per sherbim dhe biznes. Organizohet open-space, e pershtatshme per profile te ndryshme biznesi. Projekti eshte ne faze perfundimtare dhe dorzohet ne Qershor 2026.
Per me teper detaje ose vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni.
title_en: UNIT FOR SALE AT THE PARK AVENUE RESIDENCE - NEW BOULEVARD
description_en: Business unit for sale at Rezidenca Park Avenue, project of Orion Construction, in Bulervardin e Ri. The unit has a gross area of ​​204.2 m², it is located on the 5th floor of a new building dedicated to service and business. Open-space is organized, suitable for different business profiles. The project is in the final stage and will be delivered in June 2026. For more details or a visit to the property, contact me.
